com.empline/tool-documentation.access: Requires OAuth store:read consent. The connected account must own an approved store.
com.empline/tool-documentation.effects: Read-only. Website confirmation can change store-wide strategy and selected-card enrollment; this preview changes neither.
com.empline/tool-documentation.failures: Missing automationMode, non-ANY direction and malformed cursors return tool errors; no settings are changed.
com.empline/tool-documentation.notFor: One-time price changes and marketplace exports are outside this action.
com.empline/tool-documentation.purpose: Preview changes to ongoing repricing for the connected seller's cards.
com.empline/tool-documentation.returns: Returns current listing modes, store cadence, eligible rows and a website review URL; nextCursor continues the same selection.
com.empline/tool-documentation.useWhen: Use to review recurring behavior; automationMode is required and direction must be ANY, independently of one-time price direction.

description: Preview changes to ongoing repricing for the connected seller's cards. automationMode.description: Prepare OFF, recommendations, or automatically applied ongoing repricing. Does not change settings until confirmed in SuperCatch.

cardType.description: Review RAW, graded/authenticated, or all active in-stock card copies in the connected store.

cursor.description: Continue with nextCursor from the previous page, keeping the same selection.

direction.description: Filter one-time price changes. Ongoing repricing requires ANY; publishing includes all displayed cards.

integrationId.description: Choose an enabled connection ID returned in publishing.targets for this store. The seller confirms the exact account before a normal export job is queued.

strategy.description: AT_MARKET, PREMIUM (above market), or MOVE_FAST. Omit to use the existing store strategy. Confirmed automation uses this as store-wide strategy.
